recentItems.title: Minister who led airlift which evacuated 15,000 from Kabul reflects on mission
recentItems.description:
Holding back tears, Veterans & People Minister Calvin Bailey explained how the Air Mobility Force he commanded in 2021 stood and clapped the Parachute Regiment as they boarded the last flight out of Kabul.

Mr Bailey was a wing commander and the OC of 70 Squadron when he was tasked with this key role on Operation Pitting, the mission stood up to evacuate Afghan people who served alongside British forces after the Taliban seized back control.

Five years on and he's reflecting on what must have seemed an impossible mission.

recentItems.title: How can battlefield deadlock in Ukraine be broken?
recentItems.description:
The UK has handed final blueprints for Storm Shadow missiles to Kyiv, while a treasure trove of battlefield data is coming to Britain.  Can this tech-swap help Ukraine break through front lines largely frozen because of drone saturation in the skies?

Professor Michael Clarke explains how Storm Shadow could help Ukraine push through Russian lines, but won’t be a game changer on its own.

And electronic-warfare expert Dr Thomas Withington tells Sitrep how Ukrainian drone recordings could be invaluable for the UK if it ever needs to take on Russian air defences.

Plus former UK Military Attaché to Russia, John Foreman, assesses the surprise visit of the CIA Director to Moscow and tells Sitrep why the size of your plane really matters on such trips.

Sian Grzeszczyk Melbourne presents, with expert analysis from Professor Michael Clarke.

recentItems.title: Ukrainian Marine, combat medic and poet honours fallen comrades
recentItems.description:
Yaryna Chornohuz is one of Ukraine's best-known war poets who, as a battle-hardened soldier, has used her verse to capture the raw emotion of the conflict. 

To mark Ukrainian Independence Day she read her poem The Ones Who Will Die Fighting for BFBS Forces News. 

She joined the military as a volunteer combat medic in 2019 and, following Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022, has challenged gender stereotypes though becoming a marine and drone pilot.

Camera 🎥 Lewis Bartley

More💻: https://www.forcesnews.com/ukraine/lines-frontline-ukrainian-poet-whos-become-soldier-defend-her-country
